news_items.headline: Chevron declares $1.78 quarterly dividend; ex-date May 19, 2026
news_items.summary: CVX declared a $1.78 quarterly cash dividend with ex-date May 19, 2026, reinforcing shareholder return commitment alongside Q1 2026 $2.5B buyback.

news_items.headline: Chevron joins Shell and QatarEnergy in Uruguay upstream alliance
news_items.summary: CVX entered an upstream alliance with Shell and QatarEnergy in Uruguay, expanding its international exploration footprint.

news_items.headline: CVX shares tick up; upside capped by resistance at $198 (weekly report)
news_items.summary: Chevron closed the week at $191.96, +$1.37 (+0.73%) over seven trading days. Weekly indicators on Buy/Strong Buy; consolidation near highs with potential breakout above $198 resistance.

news_items.headline: Chevron expands Venezuela heavy-oil footprint via asset swaps; RBC raises PT
news_items.summary: Chevron expanded its Venezuelan presence through asset swaps, enhancing heavy-oil footprint. RBC Capital raised its price target citing the strategic moves and rising crude prices.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: RBC Capital raised PT this week alongside Venezuela expansion narrative. Broader 42-analyst median PT $220 (high $236, low $170); 25-analyst sub-survey shows 18 Buy / 6 Hold / 1 Sell — overall Strong Buy consensus (8.3/10).
